reviews.title: Presentation Designer
reviews.text:
I am multimedia designer. So a big portion of my job is creating slides for presentations. Whether they are public facing, internal, or as big as being presented at trade shows.  

As a professional, this app is terrible. It barely resembles the same product as desktop powerpoint. I understand them wanting to make features more streamlined for ipad but it doesn’t work. (It is possible, look at photoshop and Affinity designer, they at least have similar flows as their desktop siblings) 

Maybe this is just for my use case, but it doesn’t work. it combines photos and texts as groups. embedded fonts do not transfer,  looks completely different when you open the same presentation on a desktop. It might even be worse than powerpoint online. The list is endless.

If you are in a pinch and need to make presentation and don’t have access to your computer. I would just take your loss, it’s not worth using this app.

Powerpoint > Google Slides > PPT Online > PPT Ipad App

Usually have to turn Apple IPad 13 tablet off and then turn it on again for it to work.  Sometimes this still does not the solve the problem.  In addition, there are other features of PowerPoint that do not work such as line spacing, changing the starting number for number and bullet feature.  Just a few of the problems that I am experiencing with PowerPoint
